concerns.text: The plan states it will download “200 HCP minimally preprocessed 4 mm parcellated resting‑state fMRI time series” (see first paragraph). The cited Hugging Face dataset (`jonxuxu/HCP-flat`) does not explicitly guarantee a 4 mm parcellation; its description only mentions “parcellated time series” without specifying voxel size. If the dataset is at the standard 2 mm resolution, the spatial smoothing assumptions of the analysis (e.g., parcel‑wise entropy) may be invalid, jeopardizing the scientific question. A dataset explicitly providing 4 mm parcellated data (or a documented resampling step) must be cited or the plan must include a verified resampling procedure.

The DSRT (Domain‑Specific Risk‑Taking) scores are claimed to be sourced from the Hugging Face URL `https://huggingface.co/datasets/dsrtrain/augmath_prompt/...`. The dataset name `augmath_prompt` suggests it contains math‑prompt data, not behavioral risk‑taking scores. This mismatch means the predictor variable (DSRT) will be unavailable, making the core hypothesis untestable. The plan must replace this citation with a verified dataset that actually provides DSRT scores (e.g., the HCP behavioral “Risk‑Taking” measure or another open‑access risk‑taking questionnaire) and update the download logic accordingly.
